links.outcome: Physician-CAD CXR concordance and Xpert referral/yield over time alongside physician training
links.effect: Concordance of physician and CAD TB-presumptive CXRs rose from 47.3% at three months to 76.1% at nine months; Xpert-confirmed TB per 100,000 CXRs rose from 858 to 2112. No comparison group.
links.quote: Concordance between physician and CAD CXR results improved with training and was important to optimize Xpert testing.

unlisted_practices: Parallel physician and CAD reading of chest radiographs to standardize interpretation in TB case finding

screen.reason: This is an empirical implementation study evaluating real-world integration of CAD (qXR 3.0) into routine district clinic workflows for TB screening, assessing the impact of a programmatic implementation framework and staff training over time.

primary.practice: implementation framework and clinician training with threshold-based CAD integration
